name: agent_recv
description: Receive pending mailbox messages for this session, waiting (parked at this session's runner) up to the bounded timeout when none are pending. A child parked here yields its execution slot. Delivery is at-least-once: unconsumed deliveries are re-delivered after a crash, deduped on message_id. One receive is live per session: a newer call supersedes an older parked one, and the superseded call completes SUCCESSFULLY with no messages and a `disposition` saying it yielded — nothing was lost, do not retry it. On timeout the verdict follows the caller's role: a coordinator gets a SUCCESSFUL empty result whose `disposition` says nothing arrived and to receive again if children are still running; a leaf gets an error telling it to finish.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a message (default 60, max 600); on timeout a coordinator gets a successful empty result with a disposition, a leaf an error

disposition.description: Set only when this call yielded to a newer receive for the same session: a successful receive that delivered nothing and must not be retried. Absent on a delivering receive.

items.description: A delivered message, as agent_recv returns it: the runner's projection of a file swept from the run's in/ spool (or the coordinator's, from the owner's). Reply via PeerSendRequest.in_reply_to. It never rides the wire between coordinator and runner: the file is the message, and it is durable there.

kind.description: The message's kind, from a CLOSED vocabulary — guaranteed to be one of these names, because an unrecognised value is refused at ingress rather than delivered unclassified. A SENDER could only have set one of MESSAGE_KIND_MESSAGE, MESSAGE_KIND_RESULT, MESSAGE_KIND_ERROR, MESSAGE_KIND_QUESTION; the rest are minted by the coordinator itself and are therefore trustworthy as to provenance. MESSAGE_KIND_USER_INJECTED means a human injected text into a session you supervise; MESSAGE_KIND_EXITED means a child of yours ended; MESSAGE_KIND_REPORT means a child of yours filed its FINAL report (read it from roster); MESSAGE_KIND_SUMMARIZE is the coordinator asking you for a summary, answered with in_reply_to; MESSAGE_KIND_USER_CONTROL and MESSAGE_KIND_STEER are control-plane notices.

structured.description: Structured companion the sender attached, when there is one. This object no longer carries the message kind — read the `kind` field.
